All eighteen playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Critical issues**
- **INDEMN (missing)** — There is no indemnification section at all; the document jumps from §19 to §21 while §§9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 all assume indemnities exist (§9.3 even cross-refers to a non-existent §20.5). We inserted a new Section 20 with a Vendor IP/breach-of-law/data-incident/wilful-misconduct indemnity, a narrow Customer indemnity, standard procedure, and procure-modify-replace-refund remedies.
- **IP (deviation)** — §14.2 gives Vendor ownership of every Deliverable with only a revocable, non-transferable term licence to us. Flipped to Customer ownership with assignment (perpetual irrevocable licence as fallback); Vendor keeps Vendor Technology under §14.3.
- **LOL-CAP (compliant)** — §21 is already at our preferred position (mutual greater-of 12 months' Fees / USD 1M cap, full Excluded Claims list, payment obligations excluded).

**High-severity issues**
- **NONCOMPETE**, **EXCLUSIVITY/MFN** — deleted the 24-month worldwide non-compete (§12.4 second instance) and the disclose-and-match clause (§7.2 first instance), both of which contradict §12.3.
- **T4C (missing)** — added a Customer-only 30-day convenience right with pro-rata refund; Vendor gets no mid-term exit.
- **MINCOMMIT** — replaced the USD 2M/year, three-year take-or-pay with a 12-month, reducible commitment and true-up.
- **ASSIGN**, **LICENSE** — compliant as drafted.

**Medium/low**
- **NOSOLICIT** — narrowed to mutual, 12 months, involved personnel, with advertising carve-out; no-hire deleted.
- **GOVLAW** — replaced Singapore law/venue with New York law, resolving the conflict with §28.2.
- **RENEWAL**, **AUDIT**, **WARRANTY**, **INSURANCE**, **LD** — compliant.
- **TRANSITION (missing)** — added six months' transition assistance, 30-day data return in machine-readable format, and certified deletion.
